subject.title: fix(codex): stop stale MCP child processes with revalidated SIGKILL escalation

question: Should the Codex extension forcibly SIGKILL a still-running Computer Use MCP helper two seconds after cleanup sends SIGTERM?
rationale: The code can revalidate process identity, but it cannot establish whether a live matching helper may still be doing supported work or whether abrupt termination is acceptable for the bundled Codex runtime.

options.title: Keep SIGTERM-only cleanup
options.body: Do not merge the escalation until a supported macOS lifecycle proves a remaining helper is safe to hard-kill.

options.title: Approve bounded escalation
options.body: Document that stale matching Computer Use MCP children may be SIGKILLed after the grace period and require supported macOS proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep SIGTERM-only cleanup
recommendation.body: Do not merge the escalation until a supported macOS lifecycle proves a remaining helper is safe to hard-kill.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex-extension contribution is the strongest available routing signal for the runtime-contract decision.
